data.anti_aliasing: per source axis: Gaussian FWHM = max(source spacing, target voxel), then ONE linear resample, > 0.5 (orchestrator 2026-09-28)

one_voxel_reference.rule: Dice of the label vs itself shifted exactly one voxel (0.25 mm) along the grid axis closest to its thinnest principal axis (PCA of voxel world coords; integer shift, no interpolation; mean of +/-)

data.primary_rationale: demons (whole volume) is primary: statistical adequacy, decided before comparing variants (orchestrator 2026-09-27); real-section scoring kept as a secondary row where both sides have >= 50 voxels (it scored higher, so the choice is conservative)
data.chain_override: R1 of record per paper/numbers/r1_current_2026-10-03.json: MR243 r1v3, MR252 r1v3mr, MR256 r1v3mr

variants.sheet_sdf: sections rebuilt by plain SDF interpolation, ends extended half a spacing
variants.demons_real_sections: demons labels scored on real-section voxels only (provenance 1)
